title: Exact coherent phase-cache selection with a counted online bit controller

claims.statement: For every N >= 2 and every s in Z/NZ, put n=ceil(log2 N). Use the bank-first algorithm with Q=192 for N=2 and Q=27648(2n+20) for N>=3, r=Q/3, QPE width t=n+18, J=n+24, Bclk=2^(ceil(n/2)+32) and d=ceil(n/2)+32. The exact coherent prefixes and identical fresh/saved phase map use R=32 and b=ceil(log2 n)+48. The full QND/statistical/endpoint proof is in critical_third_cache_l2.md; the exact clock search, uniform pivots and caps are in critical_third_cache_l2_selector.md; the all-word phase/error/cache-boundary proof is in critical_third_cache_l2_phase.md; the full controller count and complete selected online bit/head/marker/scan algorithm are in critical_third_cache_l2_controller.md Section 10, with whole-tick raw count O(n^2 log2(n+2)) and every action/address dispatch charged. All four files are required evidence for every claim. N=2 uses the fixed-size exact trit endpoint and skips coarse selection. For N>=3 the selector executes exactly Bclk public ticks, retaining completed stages and one unfinished stage. The same implementation satisfies every bound on every execution branch for every input permitted by claim 5 with epsilon(n)=1/3, including the clean case. All five claims hold jointly with unconditional full-secret success probability at least 11/16. Constants are absolute and independent of N, s, the bank and outcomes. Worst-case total sequential work is T=O(2^(n/2)n^2(log2(n+2))^2), including source cost n+1 per copy, all Boolean and classical operations, complete forward and inverse circuits, measurements, initialization, prefix setup, exact tick control, phase-word generation, every indexed address charge, and all capped or unfinished work. The supported time envelope B_T(n)=2^(n/2)n^2(log2(n+2))^2 has growth index exactly 1.

All Q raw registers arrive before any algorithm measurement, private random draw, source transformation or abort. For a fixed but unknown set B of at most r registers, let G be its complement and sigma be the bank state. The promise is Tr_B sigma=rho_s^(tensor G), where rho_s=(1/N) sum_x |psi_(x,s)><psi_(x,s)| and |psi_(x,s)>=(|0,x>+|1,(x+s) mod N>)/sqrt(2). The state on B is arbitrary and may be entangled with G; any purification reference is inaccessible. The guarantee also holds for convex mixtures of such fixed-B inputs. The algorithm does not know B, and the source cannot access the bank or workspace after acquisition. This is a batch clean-marginal promise, not an interactive replacement service. For every such input, including B empty, the algorithm outputs the entire s with unconditional probability at least 11/16. On every execution branch, the same algorithm jointly has T=O(2^(n/2)n^2(log2(n+2))^2), S_C=O(n), S_Q=O(n^2), and exactly Q acquired source copies, hence Q=O(n). All hidden constants are absolute and independent of N, s, the input bank and outcomes.

structured.error_model: Among the Q acquired copies, an adversary fixes a set B of at most floor(epsilon(n) Q) malformed positions, possibly depending on N and s. The joint state is arbitrary subject to its reduced state on all other positions being exactly rho_s^{tensor (Q-|B|)}. Malformed systems may be correlated or entangled with each other and with other systems subject to that marginal promise. No source control, purification access, or preparation inverse is supplied.
